description: Lists the drip autoresponder campaigns on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`). Optionally filter by status (default "all" = every status), mirroring the dashboard filter tabs. Set include_analytics=true only when the user asks for stats/performance (it costs an extra analytics lookup per page). Each item then also carries an analytics object: sent, seen, clicked, ctr, goal_count, goal_value.

include_analytics.description: When true, include per-campaign analytics (sent/seen/clicked/CTR and goal count/value). Costs an extra analytics lookup, so only set it when the user asks for stats/performance.

limit.description: How many to return per page. Min 1, max 100, default 10.

status.description: Filter by status. "all" (default) returns every status.

name: pushengage_list_drip_campaigns
title: List drip campaigns
